summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 2024.0 New Feature - Automatic Conversion of Virtual Models In this tutorial, we will introduce you to the new feature in the 2024 version: the automatic virtual model conversion. ## Automatic Virtual Model Conversion You can automatically convert the virtual model created in other software to the default virtual model of Marvelous Designer. 1. Click the main menu. 2. Navigate to **Virtual Model**. 3. Select **Automatically Convert Virtual Model**. In the automatic virtual model window, you can import your virtual model from the original file. ### Supported File Formats You can import AVT, OBJ, or FBX files. We recommend using the APOS virtual model. ### Selecting Default Virtual Model Type According to gender and age, choose the right default virtual model type. You can select from the default female, male, girl, boy, or baby virtual models of Marvelous Designer. ## Conversion Options In the options for conversion, you can choose to automatically convert. For defaults, you can select “default” when applicable. ### Adjusting Model Posture and Size The default virtual model's posture and size can be adjusted to ensure that the resulting submission is accurate. 1. Head to the main menu. 2. Go to **Virtual Model**. 3. Select **Virtual Model Editor** to change the size. Click **Shift + X** to open the connections to change the posture. Try to align the default model closely with the prototype. ### Removing Hands and Feet If you choose to remove the hands and feet, the model's hands and feet will be converted to the hands and feet of the default virtual model of Marvelous Designer. ## Understanding Conversion Types What is the introduction of the conversion type? - **MD Skin Type**: When choosing this option, the body type of the prototype will be kept, but only the outer shape will be converted. The model type will be changed to resemble the Marvelous Designer virtual model, and joint points will be increased. - **Only Binding Bone Structure**: This option will maintain the original model's body shape and appearance while increasing the joint points. - **Size to be Edited**: This will use the body shape of the current virtual model and increase the joint points so that you can modify its size in the Marvelous Designer virtual model editor. ### Setting the Save Path In the save path, you can set the saved file name and file path. Click the **Convert** button to start converting virtual models according to your specifications. ## Post-Conversion After the conversion is complete, choose to open the file folder where the converted virtual model is located. Click **Close** and go to the 3D window to view the converted virtual models. ### Viewing Converted Virtual Models These three virtual models are displayed in the order of MD skin type, binding bone structure, size, and edit in the 3D window. ## Importing FBX Files Now let's import an FBX file that does not have a binding bone structure. Select the MD skin type and the option to only bind the bone structure for automatic conversion. You will see that by automatically converting virtual models, even if the original model does not have a binding bone structure, it can automatically bind the bone structure. ## Enhanced Features in the New Version In addition, the new version supports the simultaneous preservation of the arrangement of multiple virtual models and the arrangement version. Converted virtual models can now utilize functions that are exclusive to Marvelous Designer virtual models, such as using random action files, opening up software model simulation, and more follow-up functions. ```
